card.name: Inside Japanese and foreign proper names
card.fires_on: The middle or final piece of a Japanese-style proper name split into several parts, such as a place, person, animal or eponymous disease name (Shibuya, Chiba, Takotsubo, Toshieba).

modes.label: Japanese place and person names
modes.description: Final syllable of a Japanese place or person name broken into pieces.

modes.label: Japanese eponymous disease term
modes.description: Middle piece of the Japanese term Takotsubo in a cardiomyopathy name.

modes.label: Other foreign names
modes.description: Ending of a non-English name such as the Finnish epic Kalevala.

card.plain: It fires partway through unusual foreign names, mostly Japanese ones, such as the Japanese-named Takotsubo cardiomyopathy.
